outcomes.outcome: Execute Automated Tests Against a Localhost Target
outcomes.description: Configure the Playwright test runner with scenario, browser, headless preference, and a localhost URL, then run, stop, or reset the test suite without OIDC authentication.

scenarios.scenario: Run the automated test suite against a localhost URL
scenarios.description: The QA Engineer selects Breezeai sanity localhost as the test scenario, provides the localhost URL, and submits the test run. The server generates a patched spec with the localhost URL replacing the default dev URL, then spawns Playwright. OIDC authentication is bypassed. Runs up to 45 minutes.

actions.description: label: Test Scenario; type: enum; required: true; default: Breezeai sanity dev; options: Breezeai sanity dev, Breezeai sanity localhost, Breezeai sanity prod, Breezeai complete regression dev, AccionConnect sanity dev, AccionConnect sanity prod; select Breezeai sanity localhost to activate localhost mode; control disabled while test run is in progress
label: Browser; type: enum; required: true; default: Chromium; options: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit; control disabled while test run is in progress

actions.action: Indicate whether to run in headless mode
actions.description: label: Run in headless mode; type: boolean; required: false; default: false (headed); when true the browser window is hidden; control disabled while test run is in progress

label: Localhost URL; type: URL text; required: true in localhost mode; default: http://localhost:5173; validation: must be valid http or https URL; error: Enter a valid localhost URL e.g. http://localhost:5173; visible only when scenario is Breezeai sanity localhost; note: runs a generated copy of the sanity suite against this URL with no authentication required

Submits test run config to server; request: testScenario, browser, headless, isLocalhost true, localhostUrl; server generates tests/sanity.localhost.spec.mjs and spawns Playwright with --workers=1; response: success, logs, reportAvailable, customReportAvailable, customReportPath

scenarios.description: The QA Engineer halts an in-progress test run. A confirmation prompt is presented before the stop request is sent. If confirmed, the server kills the Playwright process tree. Only available while a test run is in progress.

steps.step: Confirm and stop the test run

actions.action: Confirm intent to stop the test run
actions.description: User is presented with a confirmation prompt: Stop test execution? This will attempt to cancel the running test. User must confirm to proceed; if cancelled no action is taken; no network call is made at this step; only available when testInProgress is true

Sends a stop signal to the server after confirmation; request: empty body; server kills the Playwright process tree using taskkill on Windows or SIGTERM on POSIX; response: success true with message or success false with error

scenarios.description: When the dashboard UI is stuck after an incomplete run, the QA Engineer force-resets the server run state. A confirmation prompt is shown. The server kills any running test process and clears state flags. The UI returns to an idle state.

steps.step: Confirm and reset the server run state

actions.action: Confirm intent to reset the server run state
actions.description: User is prompted: Reset run state on server? This will attempt to kill any running test and clear UI state. User must confirm to proceed; if cancelled no action is taken; no network call is made at this step

Force-resets run state on server; request: empty body; server kills any running test process and clears testRunInProgress and currentChild flags; response: success true with message Run state reset on server or success false with error

outcomes.outcome: Monitor Test Execution and Access Reports
outcomes.description: Observe real-time test log output, track run status, and open generated reports after test completion.

scenarios.scenario: Monitor live test progress and run status
scenarios.description: While a test run executes, the QA Engineer observes timestamped log entries and a run status badge that updates as the test progresses. The client automatically polls the server every 3 seconds to reconcile state and detect run completion.

actions.description: label: Status; source: runStatus state; displayed as a color-coded badge; values: IDLE (grey), RUNNING (amber), PASSED (green), FAILED (red), STOPPED (red)

actions.action: Review the current test context summary
actions.description: label: Scenario/Browser/Mode summary line; source: testScenario, browser, headless state; displayed as subtitle below the Live Test Logs heading; format: scenario name - browser name - Headed or Headless

label: Live Test Logs; source: testLogs array; each entry prefixed with timestamp in HH:MM:SS format; panel auto-scrolls to latest entry; empty state when idle: No test logs yet. Configure and run a test to begin; empty state when running: Running logs will appear here

label: notification; source: notification state; type: transient inline message; visible when notification is non-null; examples: Stopping test, Test execution stopped by user, Run state reset, Resetting run state; auto-clears after 5 seconds

steps.step: Retrieve the current run status from the server

actions.action: Retrieve the current run status from the server
actions.description: Automatic background poll every 3 seconds while testInProgress is true; response updates customReportAvailable, customReportPath, runStatus, processCompleted; when testRunInProgress becomes false the UI marks the run as completed and sets runStatus to passed or failed accordingly

scenarios.scenario: Access the test report after run completion
scenarios.description: After a test run completes, the QA Engineer opens the generated report in a new browser tab. If a custom HealingReporter HTML report exists it is prioritised over the standard Playwright HTML report. The reporting section is only visible once processCompleted is true.

steps.step: Review report availability after run completion

actions.description: label: Reporting section; source: customReportAvailable, reportAvailable, testFailed state; displays View Custom Report if customReportAvailable is true; Download Playwright Report if reportAvailable is true and customReportAvailable is false; No report found due to script failure if testFailed is true; No report available for this run otherwise; visible only after processCompleted is true

Opens the custom HealingReporter HTML report in a new browser tab; condition: customReportAvailable is true; report contains test summary with Total Passed Failed Skipped Duration and per-test result rows with error details; request: no body; response: custom HTML report from custom-reports/report-*.html

apis.response: HTML file (custom HealingReporter report from custom-reports/report-*.html)

actions.description: Opens the standard Playwright HTML report in a new browser tab; condition: reportAvailable is true and customReportAvailable is false; report served from playwright-report/index.html; request: no body; response: Playwright HTML report file

apis.response: HTML file (Playwright HTML report from playwright-report/index.html)
